title: zazzle-csharp-indexer features
description: Behaviour that spans the server, the hook and the report.

entities.name: Usage-shaped improvement loop
entities.description: Every call and redirect is recorded locally, agents can say what was missing with zazzle_report_gap, and one command turns that into what to build next.
entities.behavior: McpServer logs each internal tool call zazzled makes with its timing, size, result counts and how the answer was produced; the hook logs each block and each # allow-raw escape; gap reports come from zazzle_report_gap (zazzle report-gap), which zazzled hands to the indexer's report_gap tool, which stores the note; zazzle-csharp-indexer report summarises per tool, per resolution path, redirected commands, waste signals, errors and the latest gap notes.
entities.outcome: The owner can see which structure tools agents use through zazzle, where the index could not answer, what they still do by hand and what they missed, from real sessions.
constraints: Free-text arguments are hashed unless ZAZZLE_INDEXER_LOG_PLAIN=1.
The log rotates at 20 MiB, keeping one previous file; report reads both.
Everything stays in the state directory; nothing is sent anywhere.

relatedViews.relationship: Reviewing the report, and the hook's redirects that feed it.
